scanNote:
WORKBOOK 55-BET. Unit 13 — taklifni qabul qilish/rad etish, Avstraliya rejalari.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 13-mashq (4 tanlov), 14a (5 ta T/F), 14b (jadvalning 6 sababi), 15-mashq (xat namunasi).

⚠ 13-MAShQ — QABUL QILISh va RAD ETISh IBORALARI:
  QABUL: 'That would be nice.' · 'Yes, please. I'd love to.'
  RAD: 'I'm sorry, but I can't.' · 'I can't, but maybe another time.'
  ⚠ NOTO'G'RI variantlar ham o'rgatuvchi: 'I'm afraid it isn't' (savolga mos emas), 'I'm fine, thanks' (bu — 'How are you?' javobi), 'Yes. I love to' (grammatik xato: 'I'd love to' bo'lishi kerak), 'I'm sorry, I don't' (tugallanmagan).
  ⚠ 'I'D LOVE TO' — 'would love to' qisqartmasi. 'I love to' XATO, chunki bu odatni bildiradi.

⚠ 14a — BESh JAVOB (F, T, F, T, F) dialogdan aniq chiqadi:
  1 Amerika emas, AVSTRALIYA · 3 velosiped emas, MAShINA ijaraga oladi · 5 stereo emas, VIDEOKAMERA oladi.

⚠ FAKT — KO'PChILIK ADAShADIGAN JOY: dialogda 'CANBERRA, THE CAPITAL CITY' deyilgan. Avstraliyaning poytaxti haqiqatan KANBERRA, Sidney EMAS.
  ⚠ Sidney eng katta shahar, lekin poytaxt emas. Kitob buni to'g'ri ko'rsatgan.

⚠ Boshqa joy nomlari ham to'g'ri: Sydney Opera House (Sidney opera teatri), the Great Barrier Reef (Katta to'siq rifi — dunyodagi eng katta marjon rifi).

sections.title: Communication: Accepting & Refusing Invitations
sections.titleUz: Muloqot: Taklifni qabul qilish va rad etish

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the dialogues below and choose the correct replies. Which express acceptance and which express refusal?
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi dialoglarga qarang va to'g'ri javoblarni tanlang. Qaysilari qabul qilishni, qaysilari rad etishni bildiradi?
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT DIALOG — har birida IKKI variant.
Faqat BITTASI to'g'ri; ikkinchisi grammatik
yoki ma'no jihatdan XATO.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  a)  I'm sorry, but I can't.      →  RAD ETISh
  2  b)  That would be nice.          →  QABUL QILISh
  3  a)  Yes, please. I'd love to.    →  QABUL QILISh
  4  a)  I can't, but maybe another time.
                                      →  RAD ETISh

  QABUL QILISh (acceptance):  2, 3
  RAD ETISh (refusal):        1, 4


NOTO'G'RI VARIANTLAR NEGA XATO:

  1 b) 'I'm afraid it isn't.'
     Bu javob 'Is it ...?' savoliga mos kelardi.
     Bu yerda savol 'DO YOU WANT to come?' —
     javob 'I can't' bo'lishi kerak, 'it isn't'
     emas. MA'NO mos emas.

  2 a) 'I'm fine, thanks.'
     Bu — 'How are you?' savoliga javob!
     Taklifga javob emas. MA'NO mos emas.

  3 b) 'Yes. I love to.'
     GRAMMATIK XATO: 'I'd love to' bo'lishi kerak
     ('I WOULD love to').
     'I love to' — tugallanmagan gap.

  4 b) 'I'm sorry, I don't.'
     GRAMMATIK XATO: savol 'WOULD you like to
     come?' — javobda 'don't' emas, 'can't'
     yoki 'I'd love to, but ...' kerak.


TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR VA TARJIMASI:

  1  A: What are you doing on Sunday, Pat?
     B: I'm going to a concert in the park.
        Do you want to come?
     A: I'm sorry, but I can't.

     (Yakshanba kuni nima qilyapsan, Pet? —
      Parkdagi konsertga boryapman. Kelishni
      xohlaysanmi? — Kechirasan, lekin bora
      olmayman.)

  2  A: Are you doing anything on Wednesday
        evening, Jim?
     B: Yes, I'm meeting Steve. Do you want to
        come with me?
     A: That would be nice.

     (Chorshanba kechqurun biror ish qilyapsanmi,
      Jim? — Ha, Stiv bilan uchrashyapman. Men
      bilan kelishni xohlaysanmi? — Zo'r bo'lardi.)

  3  A: Are you going out on Saturday, Ben?
     B: Yes, I'm having dinner with Ted and Joan.
        Do you want to join us?
     A: Yes, please. I'd love to.

     (Shanba kuni sayrga chiqyapsanmi, Ben? —
      Ha, Ted va Joan bilan kechki ovqat
      qilyapman. Bizga qo'shilishni xohlaysanmi? —
      Ha, iltimos. Bajonidil.)

  4  A: What are you doing at the weekend, Anne?
     B: I'm driving to the mountains.
        Would you like to come?
     A: I can't, but maybe another time.

     (Dam olish kunlari nima qilyapsan, Enn? —
      Tog'larga haydab ketyapman. Kelishni
      xohlaysizmi? — Bora olmayman, lekin balki
      boshqa safar.)


QABUL QILISh IBORALARI:
     Yes, please. I'd love to.   (Bajonidil.)
     That would be nice.         (Zo'r bo'lardi.)
     Yes, I'd love to.           (Ha, xursandman.)
     That sounds great.          (Ajoyib.)

RAD ETISh IBORALARI:
     I'm sorry, but I can't.
        (Kechirasiz, lekin bora olmayman.)
     I can't, but maybe another time.
        (Bora olmayman, lekin balki boshqa safar.)
     I'd love to, but I can't.
        (Juda xohlardim, lekin bora olmayman.)


ENG MUHIM QOIDA — MULOYIM RAD ETISh:
  Ingliz tilida taklifni rad etganda faqat 'No'
  deyish QO'POL hisoblanadi.
  DOIM ikki narsa qo'shiladi:
     1) UZR ('I'm sorry') yoki AFSUS
        ('I'd love to')
     2) SABAB yoki KELAJAKKA ishora
        ('maybe another time')

  Coursebook 97-betdagi 15-mashqda ham shu
  qoida bor edi.


DIQQAT — BARCHA SAVOLLAR PRESENT CONTINUOUS DA:
  'What are you DOING on Sunday?'
  'Are you DOING anything on Wednesday?'
  'Are you GOING OUT on Saturday?'
  'What are you DOING at the weekend?'

  Chunki BELGILANGAN rejalar so'ralmoqda.


DIQQAT — TAKLIF QILISh IKKI XIL:
  'DO YOU WANT to come?'      — oddiy, norasmiy
  'WOULD YOU LIKE to come?'   — MULOYIMROQ

  4-dialogda 'Would you like ...?' ishlatilgan —
  eng muloyim shakl.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  acceptance  = qabul qilish
  refusal     = rad etish
  to join     = qo'shilmoq
  another time = boshqa safar
  I'm afraid  = afsuski (yumshoq rad etish)

items.textEn: 1  A: Do you want to come? — a) I'm sorry, but I can't.  /  b) I'm afraid it isn't.
items.answer: a) I'm sorry, but I can't.  — RAD ETISH
options: a) I'm sorry, but I can't.  — RAD ETISH
items.uz: Kelishni xohlaysanmi? — Kechirasan, lekin bora olmayman.
items.whyUz:
a) TO'G'RI — MULOYIM RAD ETISH.
'I'm sorry, but I can't' — uzr + imkonsizlik.

b) XATO: 'I'm afraid it ISN'T' javobi
'Is it ...?' savoliga mos kelardi.
Bu yerda savol 'DO YOU WANT to come?' —
javobda 'I can't' bo'lishi kerak.

items.textEn: 2  A: Do you want to come with me? — a) I'm fine, thanks.  /  b) That would be nice.
items.answer: b) That would be nice.  — QABUL QILISH
options: b) That would be nice.  — QABUL QILISH
items.uz: Men bilan kelishni xohlaysanmi? — Zo'r bo'lardi.
items.whyUz:
b) TO'G'RI — QABUL QILISH.
'That would be nice' = Zo'r bo'lardi.

a) XATO: 'I'm fine, thanks' — bu 'HOW ARE YOU?'
savoliga javob!
Taklifga javob emas — MA'NO mos emas.

items.textEn: 3  A: Do you want to join us? — a) Yes, please. I'd love to.  /  b) Yes. I love to.
items.answer: a) Yes, please. I'd love to.  — QABUL QILISH
options: a) Yes, please. I'd love to.  — QABUL QILISH
items.uz: Bizga qo'shilishni xohlaysanmi? — Ha, iltimos. Bajonidil.
items.whyUz:
a) TO'G'RI — QABUL QILISH.
'I'D love to' = 'I WOULD love to' — bajonidil.

b) GRAMMATIK XATO: 'I love to' — tugallanmagan.
'would' ('d) TUSHIB QOLGAN.
Coursebook 97-betdagi 15-mashqda ham
'I'd love to' shakli ishlatilgan.

items.textEn: 4  A: Would you like to come? — a) I can't, but maybe another time.  /  b) I'm sorry, I don't.
items.answer: a) I can't, but maybe another time.  — RAD ETISH
options: a) I can't, but maybe another time.  — RAD ETISH
items.uz: Kelishni xohlaysizmi? — Bora olmayman, lekin balki boshqa safar.
items.whyUz:
a) TO'G'RI — MULOYIM RAD ETISH.
'I can't, BUT maybe another time' —
imkonsizlik + KELAJAKKA ishora.
Bu rad etishni yumshatadi.

b) GRAMMATIK XATO: savol 'WOULD you like ...?' —
javobda 'don't' emas, 'can't' yoki
'I'd love to, but ...' kerak.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG:

  Paul: Hi, Tony! I hear you're going to spend
        your summer holidays in Australia.
  Tony: Yes, I am. I'm going there BECAUSE I want
        to see my sister and her family.
  Paul: That sounds nice. Are you going to stay
        there long?
  Tony: Yes. I want to travel around while I'm
        there, SO I'm going to stay there for two
        months.
  Paul: Great! What are you going to do there?
  Tony: Well, I'm going to visit Sydney TO SEE the
        Opera House. I also want to visit
        Canberra, the capital city, SO I'm going
        to hire a car.
  Paul: You're so lucky! Are you going to take a
        boat out to the Great Barrier Reef?
  Tony: Yes, I really want to see all the
        colourful fish there.
  Paul: I'm sure you'll have a great time.
  Tony: Well, I'm going to take my video camera
        BECAUSE I want to show everyone what
        Australia is like when I get back.
  Paul: That's a great idea. Have fun!


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Pol:  Salom, Toni! Yozgi ta'tilingni
        Avstraliyada o'tkazmoqchi ekansan, deb
        eshitdim.
  Toni: Ha, shunday. U yerga boryapman, chunki
        opamni va uning oilasini ko'rmoqchiman.
  Pol:  Yaxshi ekan. U yerda uzoq turasanmi?
  Toni: Ha. U yerda bo'lganimda atrofni aylanib
        chiqmoqchiman, shuning uchun ikki oy
        turaman.
  Pol:  Zo'r! U yerda nima qilmoqchisan?
  Toni: Opera teatrini ko'rish uchun Sidneyga
        bormoqchiman. Shuningdek, poytaxt
        Kanberraga ham bormoqchiman, shuning
        uchun mashina ijaraga olaman.
  Pol:  Juda omading bor ekan! Katta to'siq
        rifiga qayiqda chiqmoqchimisan?
  Toni: Ha, u yerdagi rang-barang baliqlarni juda
        ko'rgim keladi.
  Pol:  Ishonchim komilki, ajoyib vaqt
        o'tkazasan.
  Toni: Ha, videokamerani olib ketmoqchiman,
        chunki qaytganimda hammaga Avstraliya
        qanaqaligini ko'rsatmoqchiman.
  Pol:  Bu zo'r fikr. Yaxshi dam ol!


ENG MUHIM — DIALOGDA UCh XIL SABAB IFODASI:

  BECAUSE (sabab):
     'I'm going there BECAUSE I want to see my
      sister.'
     'I'm going to take my video camera BECAUSE I
      want to show everyone ...'

  SO (natija):
     'I want to travel around ..., SO I'm going to
      stay for two months.'
     'I also want to visit Canberra ..., SO I'm
      going to hire a car.'

  TO + fe'l (maqsad):
     'I'm going to visit Sydney TO SEE the Opera
      House.'

  Bu — Unit 13 ning asosiy ko'nikmasi
  (Coursebook 95-bet, Grammar 57 va 59-betlar).


AVSTRALIYA HAQIDA:
  Sydney   — eng katta shahar, Opera teatri bilan
             mashhur
  Canberra — POYTAXT (Sidney emas!)
  the Great Barrier Reef — Katta to'siq rifi,
             dunyodagi eng katta marjon rifi


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to spend holidays = ta'tilni o'tkazmoq
  to travel around  = atrofni aylanib chiqmoq
  the capital city  = poytaxt
  to hire a car     = mashina ijaraga olmoq
  a reef            = rif (marjon to'sig'i)
  colourful         = rang-barang
  a video camera    = videokamera
  to get back       = qaytmoq
  Have fun!         = Yaxshi dam ol!

sentences.en: Paul: Hi, Tony! I hear you're going to spend your summer holidays in Australia.
sentences.uz: Pol: Salom, Toni! Yozgi ta'tilingni Avstraliyada o'tkazmoqchi ekansan, deb eshitdim.
sentences.noteUz:
'I hear ...' = eshitdim, xabarim bor.
'spend holidays IN + mamlakat' — predlog IN.

sentences.en: Tony: Yes, I am. I'm going there because I want to see my sister and her family.
sentences.uz: Toni: Ha, shunday. U yerga boryapman, chunki opamni va uning oilasini ko'rmoqchiman.
sentences.noteUz:
'Yes, I AM' — qisqa javob
('Are you going to ...?' savoliga).
BECAUSE — SABAB.
14b-mashqning 1-bandi shu yerdan.

sentences.en: Paul: That sounds nice. Are you going to stay there long?
sentences.uz: Pol: Yaxshi ekan. U yerda uzoq turasanmi?
sentences.noteUz:
'That sounds nice' = Yaxshi ekan
(reaksiya iborasi).
'stay LONG' — 'a long time' ning qisqasi.

sentences.en: Tony: Yes. I want to travel around while I'm there, so I'm going to stay there for two months.
sentences.uz: Toni: Ha. U yerda bo'lganimda atrofni aylanib chiqmoqchiman, shuning uchun ikki oy turaman.
sentences.noteUz:
SO — NATIJA.
'WHILE I'm there' — 'while' dan keyin
PRESENT SIMPLE ('while I will be' XATO).
'FOR two months' — davomiylik FOR.

sentences.en: Tony: Well, I'm going to visit Sydney to see the Opera House.
sentences.uz: Toni: Opera teatrini ko'rish uchun Sidneyga bormoqchiman.
sentences.noteUz:
TO + fe'l — MAQSAD.
Sidney — Avstraliyaning eng katta shahri.
'the Opera House' — Sidney opera teatri.

sentences.en: Tony: I also want to visit Canberra, the capital city, so I'm going to hire a car.
sentences.uz: Toni: Shuningdek, poytaxt Kanberraga ham bormoqchiman, shuning uchun mashina ijaraga olaman.
sentences.noteUz:
SO — NATIJA.
DIQQAT: Avstraliya poytaxti — KANBERRA,
Sidney EMAS (ko'p odam adashadi).
'to hire a car' = mashina ijaraga olmoq.

sentences.en: Paul: You're so lucky! Are you going to take a boat out to the Great Barrier Reef?
sentences.uz: Pol: Juda omading bor ekan! Katta to'siq rifiga qayiqda chiqmoqchimisan?
sentences.noteUz:
'You're so lucky!' = Omading bor ekan!
'take a boat OUT TO ...' = qayiqda chiqmoq.
'the Great Barrier Reef' — dunyodagi eng katta
marjon rifi (Avstraliya sohilida).

sentences.en: Tony: Yes, I really want to see all the colourful fish there.
sentences.uz: Toni: Ha, u yerdagi rang-barang baliqlarni juda ko'rgim keladi.
sentences.noteUz:
'really' — kuchaytiruvchi.
'FISH' — ko'pligi ham 'fish'
('fishes' odatda aytilmaydi).
'colourful' = rang-barang (britancha yozilishi;
amerikacha 'colorful').

sentences.en: Paul: I'm sure you'll have a great time.
sentences.uz: Pol: Ishonchim komilki, ajoyib vaqt o'tkazasan.
sentences.noteUz:
'I'M SURE ... WILL ...' — FIKRGA asoslangan
bashorat (Grammar 58-bet qoidasi).
'have a great time' = ajoyib vaqt o'tkazmoq.

sentences.en: Tony: Well, I'm going to take my video camera because I want to show everyone what Australia is like when I get back.
sentences.uz: Toni: Ha, videokamerani olib ketmoqchiman, chunki qaytganimda hammaga Avstraliya qanaqaligini ko'rsatmoqchiman.
sentences.noteUz:
BECAUSE — SABAB.
'what Australia IS LIKE' — 'like' bu yerda
'qanday' ma'nosida (Unit 12 dan).
'WHEN I GET back' — 'when' dan keyin
PRESENT SIMPLE ('when I will get' XATO).

sentences.en: Paul: That's a great idea. Have fun!
sentences.uz: Pol: Bu zo'r fikr. Yaxshi dam ol!
sentences.noteUz:
'Have fun!' = Yaxshi dam ol! (xayrlashuv tilagi).
Buyruq gap shaklida.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue and mark the statements below as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing va quyidagi gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh GAP — javoblar dialogdan TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI
tekshiriladi.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Tony's going to America this summer.    F
  2  Tony's going to see his sister.         T
  3  Tony's going to hire a bicycle.         F
  4  Tony's going to see the Opera House.    T
  5  Tony's going to take his stereo.        F

  T — IKKITA:  2, 4
  F — UChTA:   1, 3, 5


NAQSh — KITOB QANDAY ALDAYDI:
  Uchala 'F' bandida kitob BITTA so'zni
  almashtirgan:
     America  ←  aslida AUSTRALIA
     bicycle  ←  aslida a CAR
     stereo   ←  aslida a VIDEO CAMERA

  Ya'ni gapning tuzilishi to'g'ri, faqat
  BITTA SO'Z noto'g'ri. Diqqat bilan o'qish
  kerak.


HAR BIRI QANDAY TEKShIRILADI:

  1  Dialog: 'spend your summer holidays in
     AUSTRALIA'
     Gap: 'going to AMERICA'
     → F. Mamlakat NOTO'G'RI.

  2  Dialog: 'I want to see MY SISTER and her
     family'
     Gap: 'going to see his sister'
     → T. TO'G'RI.

  3  Dialog: 'I'm going to hire A CAR'
     Gap: 'going to hire A BICYCLE'
     → F. Transport NOTO'G'RI.

  4  Dialog: 'I'm going to visit Sydney to see
     THE OPERA HOUSE'
     Gap: 'going to see the Opera House'
     → T. TO'G'RI.

  5  Dialog: 'I'm going to take MY VIDEO CAMERA'
     Gap: 'going to take his STEREO'
     → F. Narsa NOTO'G'RI.


DIQQAT — OLMOSh O'ZGARADI:
  Dialogda Toni O'ZI gapiradi: 'MY sister',
  'MY video camera'.
  Gaplarda esa uchinchi shaxs: 'HIS sister',
  'HIS stereo'.
  Bu — normal, xato emas.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a stereo  = musiqa markazi, magnitofon
  a bicycle = velosiped

items.sentence: 1  Tony's going to America this summer.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI (F).
Dialogda: 'spend your summer holidays in
AUSTRALIA'.
Amerika EMAS — AVSTRALIYA.
Kitob BITTA so'zni almashtirgan.

items.sentence: 2  Tony's going to see his sister.
items.whyUz:
TO'G'RI (T).
Dialogda: 'I'm going there because I want to see
MY SISTER and her family.'
DIQQAT: dialogda 'MY sister', gapda 'HIS sister'
— olmosh o'zgargani normal.

items.sentence: 3  Tony's going to hire a bicycle.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI (F).
Dialogda: 'so I'm going to hire A CAR'.
Velosiped EMAS — MASHINA.
Sababi ham aytilgan: Kanberraga borish uchun.

items.sentence: 4  Tony's going to see the Opera House.
items.whyUz:
TO'G'RI (T).
Dialogda: 'I'm going to visit Sydney TO SEE THE
OPERA HOUSE.'
Sidney opera teatri — Avstraliyaning eng mashhur
binosi.

items.sentence: 5  Tony's going to take his stereo.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI (F).
Dialogda: 'I'm going to take MY VIDEO CAMERA'.
Magnitofon EMAS — VIDEOKAMERA.
Sababi ham aytilgan: hammaga Avstraliyani
ko'rsatish uchun.

exercises.instructionEn: Now fill in the chart below with the reasons.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi quyidagi jadvalni sabablar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL IKKI USTUNDAN IBORAT:
  PLANS/INTENTIONS  (rejalar va niyatlar)
  REASON/PURPOSE    (sabab va maqsad)

Kitob har ikki ustunning BIR QISMINI bergan —
qolganini dialogdan topib to'ldirasiz.


TO'LDIRILGAN JADVAL:

 ┌──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────┐
 │ PLANS/INTENTIONS         │ REASON/PURPOSE       │
 ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
 │ Tony's going to spend    │ He wants to see his  │
 │ his SUMMER HOLIDAYS IN   │ sister and her       │
 │ AUSTRALIA        (NAMUNA)│ family.     (NAMUNA) │
 ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
 │ He's going to stay there │ He wants to TRAVEL   │
 │ for TWO MONTHS           │ around while he's    │
 │                          │ there.               │
 ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
 │ He's going to visit      │ He wants to SEE the  │
 │ SYDNEY                   │ Opera House.         │
 ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
 │ He's going to hire       │ He wants to VISIT    │
 │ A CAR                    │ Canberra the capital │
 │                          │ city.                │
 ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
 │ He's going to take a     │ He wants to SEE all  │
 │ BOAT (out to the Great   │ the colourful fish.  │
 │ Barrier Reef)            │                      │
 ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
 │ He's going to take his   │ He wants to SHOW     │
 │ VIDEO CAMERA             │ everyone what        │
 │                          │ Australia is like    │
 │                          │ when he gets back.   │
 └──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────┘


QOLIP — SABAB USTUNI:
  'He WANTS TO + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .'

  Dialogda Toni O'ZI gapiradi ('I want to ...'),
  jadvalda esa UChINChI ShAXS ('He wants to ...').


HAR BIRI DIALOGNING QAYSI QATORIDAN:

  1  'I'm going there BECAUSE I WANT TO SEE my
      sister and her family.'

  2  'I WANT TO TRAVEL AROUND while I'm there, SO
      I'm going to stay there for two months.'

  3  'I'm going to visit Sydney TO SEE the Opera
      House.'
     → jadvalda: 'He wants to SEE the Opera House.'

  4  'I also WANT TO VISIT Canberra, the capital
      city, SO I'm going to hire a car.'

  5  'I really WANT TO SEE all the colourful fish
      there.'

  6  'I'm going to take my video camera BECAUSE I
      WANT TO SHOW everyone what Australia is like
      when I get back.'


ENG MUHIM KUZATUV:
  Dialogda sabab UCh xil ifodalangan
  (because / so / to + fe'l), lekin jadvalda
  HAMMASI BIR XIL shaklga keltiriladi:
     'He WANTS TO ...'

  Bu — 15-mashqdagi xat uchun tayyorgarlik.


DIQQAT — 'WHILE HE'S THERE' va 'WHEN HE GETS
BACK':
  Ikkalasida ham PRESENT SIMPLE:
     'while he'S there'   ('while he will be' XATO)
     'when he GETS back'  ('when he will get' XATO)

  'while' va 'when' dan keyin KELASI zamon
  IShLATILMAYDI.

pairs.right: He wants to see his sister and her family.
pairs.rightUz: U opasini va uning oilasini ko'rmoqchi.
pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (ikkala ustun ham).
Dialogda: 'I'm going there BECAUSE I want to see
my sister and her family.'

pairs.left: He's going to stay there for TWO MONTHS
pairs.right: He wants to TRAVEL around while he's there.
pairs.rightUz: U yerda bo'lganida atrofni aylanib chiqmoqchi.
pairs.whyUz:
Dialogda: 'I want to TRAVEL AROUND while I'm
there, SO I'm going to stay there for TWO
MONTHS.'
DIQQAT: 'while he'S there' — PRESENT SIMPLE
('while he will be' XATO).

pairs.right: He wants to SEE the Opera House.
pairs.whyUz:
Dialogda: 'I'm going to visit SYDNEY TO SEE the
Opera House.'
DIQQAT: dialogda 'to see' (maqsad), jadvalda
'He WANTS TO see' — bir xil shaklga
keltirilgan.

pairs.left: He's going to hire A CAR
pairs.right: He wants to VISIT Canberra the capital city.
pairs.whyUz:
Dialogda: 'I also want to VISIT Canberra, the
capital city, SO I'm going to hire A CAR.'
DIQQAT: Avstraliya poytaxti — KANBERRA,
Sidney EMAS.

pairs.left: He's going to take a BOAT (out to the Great Barrier Reef)
pairs.right: He wants to SEE all the colourful fish.
pairs.whyUz:
Dialogda Pol so'raydi: 'Are you going to take a
BOAT out to the Great Barrier Reef?'
Toni: 'Yes, I really want to SEE ALL THE
COLOURFUL FISH there.'
'fish' — ko'pligi ham 'fish'.

pairs.left: He's going to take his VIDEO CAMERA
pairs.right: He wants to SHOW everyone what Australia is like when he gets back.
pairs.rightUz: U qaytganida hammaga Avstraliya qanaqaligini ko'rsatmoqchi.
pairs.whyUz:
Dialogda: 'I'm going to take MY VIDEO CAMERA
BECAUSE I want to SHOW EVERYONE what Australia
is like when I get back.'
DIQQAT: 'when he GETS back' — PRESENT SIMPLE
('when he will get' XATO).

exercises.instructionEn: Tony is writing to another friend, Steve, to tell him about his holiday plans. Complete the letter using the information from Ex. 14. Say what his plans are and give the reasons.
exercises.instructionUz: Toni boshqa do'sti Stivga ta'til rejalari haqida xat yozyapti. 14-mashqdagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib xatni to'ldiring. Uning rejalarini ayting va sabablarini keltiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOB BERGAN BOShLANISh VA OXIR:

  Dear Steve,
     I'm writing to tell you about my holiday
  plans. I'm going to Australia!
     I'm leaving on 12th June. ...

  ...

     Well, that's all my news. I'll send you a
  postcard when I get to Australia.

                              Best wishes,
                              Tony


O'RTASINI 14-MAShQDAGI JADVALDAN to'ldirasiz.


TO'LIQ NAMUNA XAT:

  Dear Steve,

  I'm writing to tell you about my holiday plans.
  I'm going to Australia!

  I'm leaving on 12th June. I'm going there
  because I want to see my sister and her family.
  I'm going to stay there for two months because I
  want to travel around while I'm there.

  I'm going to visit Sydney to see the Opera
  House. I also want to visit Canberra, the
  capital city, so I'm going to hire a car.

  I'm going to take a boat out to the Great
  Barrier Reef to see all the colourful fish.
  Finally, I'm going to take my video camera
  because I want to show everyone what Australia
  is like when I get back.

  Well, that's all my news. I'll send you a
  postcard when I get to Australia.

                              Best wishes,
                              Tony


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Hurmatli Stiv,

  Senga ta'til rejalarim haqida yozyapman.
  Avstraliyaga ketyapman!

  12-iyunda jo'nayman. U yerga boryapman, chunki
  opamni va uning oilasini ko'rmoqchiman. U yerda
  ikki oy turaman, chunki bo'lganimda atrofni
  aylanib chiqmoqchiman.

  Opera teatrini ko'rish uchun Sidneyga
  bormoqchiman. Shuningdek, poytaxt Kanberraga
  ham bormoqchiman, shuning uchun mashina ijaraga
  olaman.

  Rang-barang baliqlarni ko'rish uchun Katta
  to'siq rifiga qayiqda chiqmoqchiman. Nihoyat,
  videokamerani olib ketmoqchiman, chunki
  qaytganimda hammaga Avstraliya qanaqaligini
  ko'rsatmoqchiman.

  Xo'sh, yangiliklarim shu. Avstraliyaga
  yetganimda senga otkritka yuboraman.

                              Eng yaxshi tilaklar
                              bilan,
                              Toni


ENG MUHIM — UCh SABAB IFODASINI ARALAShTIRING:

  BECAUSE ishlatilgan joylar:
     '... because I want to see my sister ...'
     '... because I want to travel around ...'
     '... because I want to show everyone ...'

  SO ishlatilgan joy:
     'I also want to visit Canberra ..., SO I'm
      going to hire a car.'

  TO + fe'l ishlatilgan joylar:
     '... to visit Sydney TO SEE the Opera House.'
     '... to the Great Barrier Reef TO SEE all the
      colourful fish.'

  Uchala shaklni ham ishlatish — mashqning
  ASOSIY maqsadi.


XAT QOLIPI (Coursebook 97-bet, Writing qutisi):
  Boshi:  'Dear + ISM,'
  Oxiri:  'Best wishes,' + ISM

  'Best Wishes' — do'st va tanishga.
  'Love' — eng yaqin do'st va qarindoshga
  (93-betdagi Jennining xatida shunday edi).


DIQQAT — ZAMONLAR:
  'I'M LEAVING on 12th June.'
     → PRESENT CONTINUOUS + ANIQ SANA
       (belgilangan reja)
  'I'M GOING TO stay there for two months.'
     → BE GOING TO (reja, aniq sana yo'q)
  'I'LL send you a postcard.'
     → WILL (va'da, ayni damdagi qaror)

  Uchala kelajak shakli ham bitta xatda!


DIQQAT — 'WHEN I GET TO AUSTRALIA':
  'when' dan keyin PRESENT SIMPLE.
  'when I WILL get' XATO.
  Xatning oxirida kitob bergan gapda ham shunday.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a postcard = otkritka
  to get to  = ... ga yetib bormoq
  news       = yangilik (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  Best wishes = eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan

structure.heading: BOShI — kitob bergan
structure.guideUz:
Kitob bu qismni O'ZI bergan.
'Dear + ISM,' — keyin vergul.
Birinchi jumla xat maqsadini aytadi.
structure.modelEn: Dear Steve, I'm writing to tell you about my holiday plans. I'm going to Australia!

structure.heading: 1-qism — jo'nash va SABAB (because)
structure.guideUz:
Kitob 'I'm leaving on 12th June.' ni bergan —
davom ettiring.

QOLIP:
  'I'm going there BECAUSE I want to [sabab].'

14b-jadvalning 1-qatoridan.
DIQQAT: 'I'm LEAVING' — present continuous +
aniq sana.
structure.modelEn: I'm leaving on 12th June. I'm going there because I want to see my sister and her family.

structure.heading: 2-qism — qancha turadi va NEGA (because)
structure.guideUz:
QOLIP:
  'I'm going to stay there for [muddat] BECAUSE I
   want to [sabab].'

14b-jadvalning 2-qatoridan.
DIQQAT: 'while I'm there' — PRESENT SIMPLE
('while I will be' XATO).
structure.modelEn: I'm going to stay there for two months because I want to travel around while I'm there.

structure.heading: 3-qism — Sidney (to + fe'l) va Kanberra (so)
structure.guideUz:
Bu yerda IKKI xil shakl ishlating:

  'I'm going to visit Sydney TO SEE ...'
     (to + fe'l — MAQSAD)
  'I also want to visit Canberra ..., SO I'm going
   to hire a car.'
     (so — NATIJA)

14b-jadvalning 3 va 4-qatorlaridan.
structure.modelEn: I'm going to visit Sydney to see the Opera House. I also want to visit Canberra, the capital city, so I'm going to hire a car.

structure.heading: 4-qism — rif va videokamera
structure.guideUz:
QOLIP:
  'I'm going to take a boat ... TO SEE ...'
     (to + fe'l)
  'Finally, I'm going to take my video camera
   BECAUSE I want to [sabab].'
     (because)

14b-jadvalning 5 va 6-qatorlaridan.
'Finally' — oxirgi bandni kiritadi.
structure.modelEn: I'm going to take a boat out to the Great Barrier Reef to see all the colourful fish. Finally, I'm going to take my video camera because I want to show everyone what Australia is like when I get back.

structure.heading: OXIRI — kitob bergan
structure.guideUz:
Kitob bu qismni ham O'ZI bergan.

DIQQAT: 'I'LL send you a postcard' — WILL
(va'da).
'when I GET to Australia' — PRESENT SIMPLE
('when I will get' XATO).
'Best wishes,' — do'stga yozilgan xat uchun.
structure.modelEn: Well, that's all my news. I'll send you a postcard when I get to Australia. Best wishes, Tony

wordFormation.introUz: 55-bet — taklifni qabul qilish/rad etish va sabab ifodalash.

groups.ruleUz: QABUL QILISh va RAD ETISh IBORALARI (13-mashq)

items.base: I can't, but maybe another time.

I want to visit Canberra, so I'm going to hire a car.

patterns.formula: Do you want to come?  —  Yes, please. I'd love to.  /  I'm sorry, but I can't.
patterns.exampleEn: Do you want to join us? — Yes, please. I'd love to.
patterns.exampleUz: Bizga qo'shilishni xohlaysanmi? — Ha, iltimos. Bajonidil.
patterns.explanationUz:
QABUL QILISH: 'I'D love to' ('would' SHART).
RAD ETISH: uzr + imkonsizlik.
Faqat 'No' — QO'POL.

patterns.formula: I'm going to [reja] BECAUSE I want to [sabab].
patterns.exampleEn: I'm going there because I want to see my sister and her family.
patterns.exampleUz: U yerga boryapman, chunki opamni va uning oilasini ko'rmoqchiman.
patterns.explanationUz:
BECAUSE — SABAB.
Ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bor.

patterns.formula: I want to [maqsad], SO I'm going to [reja].
patterns.exampleEn: I also want to visit Canberra, so I'm going to hire a car.
patterns.exampleUz: Kanberraga ham bormoqchiman, shuning uchun mashina ijaraga olaman.
patterns.explanationUz:
SO — NATIJA.
Tartib 'because' ga nisbatan TESKARI.

patterns.exampleEn: I'm going to visit Sydney to see the Opera House.
patterns.exampleUz: Opera teatrini ko'rish uchun Sidneyga bormoqchiman.
patterns.explanationUz:
TO + fe'l — MAQSAD.
Ega YO'Q, eng qisqa shakl.

patterns.formula: I'll send you a postcard WHEN I GET to Australia.
patterns.exampleEn: I'll send you a postcard when I get to Australia.
patterns.explanationUz:
'when' dan keyin PRESENT SIMPLE.
'when I will get' XATO.
Asosiy gapda esa 'will'.
